newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SLOVENIA'S SBI UP FOR FIFTH DAY, OUTLOOK BUOYANT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVENIA'S SBI UP FOR FIFTH DAY, OUTLOOK BUOYANT.

text.p: Slovenia's blue chip SBI index rose for the fifth trading session on Monday in a market pushed by mainly domestic demand, traders said.
"At the moment domestic demand is sufficient to push prices up. When holidays are over prices could rise even higher as foreign activity resumes," said Matej Tomazin, a trader at brokerage Ilirija.
* The SBI index rose 11.03 points or 0.70 percent to 1,587.92.
* Financial consultancy Finmedia was the top gainer, jumping 4.76 percent to 11,000 tolars on volume of 15 shares.
* Trading firm Kovinotehna was the most actively traded share, firming 0.91 percent to 555 tolars on volume of 7,402 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
